title: Only Half-Frozen
description: Despite being well on the way towards freezing to death, Tommy the adventurer is concerned about one thing only: his incomplete commission...

mainQuestExcel.title: Only Half-Frozen
mainQuestExcel.description: Despite being well on the way towards freezing to death, Tommy the adventurer is concerned about one thing only: his incomplete commission...

dialogs.text: T—Traveler... Could... could you h—help me...
What's wrong with you...
P—Please... I—I need some warmth... It's... t—too cold...
O—Or maybe... s—some hot food might also be g—good.
P—Please... I'm just... too c—cold...
I can help you find a heat source.
That's good... That's good. P—Please, hurry... I—I feel like I might freeze any m—moment now...
I'll make you a hot meal.
That... also works. P—Please, hurry... I—I feel like I might freeze any m—moment now...
H—Have you... found a heat source yet? I d—don't think I can... t—take much more...
H—Have you... finished making that dish yet? I d—don't think I can... t—take much more...

flow.stepDescription: Help Tommy find a source of heat

dialogs.text: Phew... Much better. Thank you, Traveler.
What brings you to this place?
*sigh* A commission, what else? I've been at the camp all this time because of a rather... tricky commission.
But I didn't want to stay there forever, so I was looking for something else to do...
The chef, Harris, was looking for someone to find some Chilled Meat up the mountain.
He said that I just needed to find some small frozen boar, and that there was no need to go too far up the mountain, so there'd be no danger at all...
I thought it sounded straightforward enough, so I accepted the commission.
I'd been preparing myself, too — training myself slowly, acclimatizing myself to Dragonspine's environment...
...All so that I might finish the commission given to me by that alchemist lady.
But I didn't expect that I'd lose my way not long after I started my ascent, and nearly get frozen in the process. I was lucky to have met you...
My only regret is that... I couldn't complete my commission...
Traveler... you seem to know this mountain well. Could I trouble you to do me a favor?
I just need you to find me one serving of Chilled Meat. Just one is fine — that is all I need to complete my commission.
I've got your back.
Thanks. In that case, let me mark the locations where Harris mentioned we might find small frozen boars on your map.
I'll head down to the camp at the base of the mountain and await your good news there.
H—Have you... found a heat source yet? I d—don't think I can... t—take much more...

flow.stepDescription: Make Tommy a serving of Delicious Radish Veggie Soup

dialogs.text: This warmth... I—It must be... R—Radish Veggie Soup!
P—Please... Give me a taste...
H—Have you... finished making that dish yet? I d—don't think I can... t—take much more...

flow.stepDescription: Give the serving of Delicious Radish Veggie Soup to Tommy
